name: codex-updater-desktop
description: Codex Desktop updater and diagnostics console
author: Codex Updater

scripts.electron:build: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis && npm run verify:package
scripts.electron:build:local: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis -c.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist && npm run verify:package
scripts.test: node tests/parse.test.cjs && node tests/verify.test.cjs && node tests/ps.test.cjs && node tests/window-controls.test.cjs && node tests/notice.test.cjs && node tests/install-location.test.cjs && node tests/busy-state.test.cjs && node tests/launch.test.cjs && node tests/rollback.test.cjs && node tests/elevation.test.cjs && node tests/repair.test.cjs
scripts.verify:render: electron scripts/verify-render.cjs && electron scripts/verify-render.cjs --not-installed && electron scripts/verify-render.cjs --health-partial && electron scripts/verify-render.cjs --installing && electron scripts/verify-render.cjs --launch-no-window && electron scripts/verify-render.cjs --launch-unknown && electron scripts/verify-render.cjs --rollback && electron scripts/verify-render.cjs --notice && electron scripts/verify-render.cjs --checking && electron scripts/verify-render.cjs --menu && electron scripts/verify-render.cjs --menu --width=760
scripts.verify:render:packaged: electron scripts/verify-render.cjs --packaged && electron scripts/verify-render.cjs --packaged --not-installed && electron scripts/verify-render.cjs --packaged --launch-no-window
